title: Chase a reply you are waiting on
summary: The job checks for an answer first, drafts one short reminder in the same thread, stops for the one approval, sends it, and waits for the reply.

payload.subject: Re: Kitchen extension quote
payload.body:
Hi Rowan,

Just following up on my message about the kitchen extension. Could you send the quote and a week you could start? We would like to book someone by the end of the month.

Thanks,
Jamie

steps.text: Sent from your address, in the same thread. I will watch for Rowan's answer.

steps.answer: Reminder sent to Rowan in the same thread. I will tell you when the answer arrives.
